items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: The first electric bass I had, I bought it from Walter Payton. ... Walter Payton wanted to buy it back from me

ctx.x: Now before Walter did a ramming on it, I had a ramming on it. You know. When I tried to get the cast together on it, man, I couldn't get them a rehearsal. And they think I know where I would and got Walter to do another ramming. Of course it wasn't the same thing. You know, the ramming wise, because you know two rangers don't think alike.
Well how did Earl bring the song to you? What did it sound like when Earl brought it?
